notes: «وبالإسناد الأول» : none of the twelve previous reports writes its chain (all has_written_chain false), so nothing is inherited and the back reference stays as written
«عن أبي عبد الله أو عن أبي جعفر» : the «أو» gives two alternatives in one level
Jabir is the last link; the Prophet's words follow («قال لنا رسول الله»), the Prophet not being a link
